title: Keep employee records for 7 years
what: Make and keep for 7 years the employee records the regulations prescribe, for each employee.

sources.title: Fair Work Act 2009
sources.quote: An employer must make, and keep for 7 years, employee records of the kind prescribed by the regulations in relation to each of its employees.

reach.note: Companies that are constitutional (trading or financial) corporations, in every state and territory.

sources.title: Fair Work Act 2009
sources.quote: A national system employer is: (a) a constitutional corporation, so far as it employs, or usually employs, an individual;

reach.note: Unincorporated employers are in the national system in the states that referred their powers and in the territories; in WA they are in the state system.

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

confidence_note: WA unincorporated employers keep records under WA law instead (phase D).

assessment.summary: Records of pay, hours and leave that payroll software keeps as a matter of course: no material effect.
